title: Bastion: Budget-Aware Speculative Decoding with Tree-structured Block Diffusion Drafting
abstract: arXiv:2605.29727v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Block-diffusion drafters have recently emerged as a powerful alternative for speculative decoding by predicting multiple future-token distributions in a single parallel step. However, since these parallel predictions are sampled from position-wise marginals rather than fully conditioned sequences, committing to a single greedy path often fails to capture the target model's preferred trajectory. To address this, we propose BASTION, a budget-aware speculative decoding framework with tree-based diffusion drafting. Unlike existing methods that rely on static tree topologies, BASTION dynamically constructs query-dependent trees by balancing draft quality against hardware constraints. Our framework integrates three synergistic components: (1) an acceptance surrogate that estimates expected accepted length via path confidence, (2) an online latency estimator that calibrates a hardware-aware roofline model, and (3) an adaptive best-first exp

translated_title: BASTION：基于树状块扩散起草的预算感知投机解码
translated_abstract: 块扩散起草器近期已成为投机解码的一种强大替代方案，它能够在单个并行步骤中预测多个未来 token 的分布。然而，由于这些并行预测是从逐位置的边缘分布中采样得到的，而非来自完全条件化的序列，因此仅承诺单一贪心路径往往无法捕捉到目标模型所偏好的轨迹。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 BASTION——一个具有树状扩散起草机制的预算感知投机解码框架。与依赖静态树拓扑的现有方法不同，BASTION 通过在起草质量与硬件约束之间进行权衡，动态构建依赖查询的树结构。我们的框架集成了三个协同工作的组件：（1）一个接受度代理，通过路径置信度估计预期接受长度；（2）一个在线延迟估计器，用于校准硬件感知的屋顶线模型；（3）一个自适应的最佳优先扩展（机制）……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BASTION 提出了一个预算感知的投机解码框架，通过动态构建依赖查询的树状扩散起草，并借助接受度估计、在线延迟估计与自适应搜索三个组件，在起草质量与硬件约束之间取得平衡，从而提升解码效率。
